name: Hiyori Sou
source: A doll version of Sou, which can be renamed by the player but is by default named Midori, is the Floor Master of the Fourth and Fifth Floors. [spoiler] He never actually died and is only over 50% doll while the rest is still human. His human hands are swapped with Mai's doll hands. [/spoiler]
translation: A doll version of Sou, which can be renamed by the player but is by default named Midori, is the Floor Master of the Fourth and Fifth Floors. [spoiler] He never actually died and is only over 50% doll while the rest is still human. His human hands are swapped with Mai's doll hands. [/spoiler]
